  `https://uiception.com/images/blocks/gallery-section-v1/${filename}`

export type GalleryItem = {
  id: string
  label: string
  alt: string
  imageSrc: string
  blurDataURL?: string
}

export const sectionMeta = {
  title: "Moments In Focus",
}
